<thought>The provided SMILES from subtask 9 does not match the given molecular formula (it yields C6H16O3). I need a SMILES that corresponds to C6H14O3, a saturated triol. A plausible structure is 1,2,3‑trihydroxyhexane: HO‑CH2‑CH(OH)‑CH(OH)‑CH2‑CH2‑CH3, which translates to the SMILES string "COC(O)C(O)CCC". This matches C6H14O3 and has DBE = 0.</thought>
<final_answer>COC(O)C(O)CCC</final_answer>
